subject.title: feat(agents): composable termination algebra + GSAR grounding scorer

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a reusable core termination/grounding policy before approving the concrete agent-loop integration and trusted-evidence contract that would use it?
rationale: The branch is intentionally library-only and current main has no caller, so code review cannot determine whether core, a narrower agent-runtime owner, or a future plugin-facing seam is the intended permanent product boundary.

options.title: Keep the direction in the tracker
options.body: Close this groundwork branch and decide the runtime owner, evidence source, and user-facing policy in the open feature discussion before implementation.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow core foundation
options.body: Explicitly approve a small core API contract and require a production caller, trusted-evidence semantics, and focused upgrade/runtime proof in a replacement PR.

options.title: Route outside core
options.body: Decide that the experimentation belongs in an agent-runtime owner or extension seam rather than as new unused core modules.

recommendation.title: Keep the direction in the tracker
recommendation.body: Close this groundwork branch and decide the runtime owner, evidence source, and user-facing policy in the open feature discussion before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved direction was explicitly routed to this person in the PR discussion and tracking context.
